title: Project Terminal puts coding agents, shells and a browser in one Mac workspace
friendlyTitle: Project Terminal keeps coding agents and project tools in one window
summary: Project Terminal is a macOS workspace for arranging Claude Code, Codex, shells, development servers and browser panes by project. It uses tmux to keep local sessions running when the app closes, stores workspace data locally and offers three projects free with a one-time paid tier.
friendlySummary: This Mac app places Claude Code, Codex, command lines, servers and a browser side by side. It keeps local sessions running with tmux and stores its own workspace information on the computer.
whyItMatters: As developers run several agents at once, coordinating sessions and noticing when human review is needed becomes a workflow problem. A project-centred view may reduce terminal switching, though users should remember that the agents themselves still connect to their own providers and carry their own data policies.
friendlyWhyItMatters: One workspace can make several coding agents easier to watch and manage. The AI tools still use their own online services, so their normal privacy rules continue to apply.
